summary: Beamr Imaging Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a CEO letter and preliminary first-half 2026 financial update. The letter discusses strategic shifts toward autonomous-vehicle markets, reported ~$0.9M revenue (down from $1.07M) and $7.7M cash. No special-situation event is announced; the filing is a routine business update for a foreign private issuer. There are no terms, no board recommendation, no mechanics or risk-arb angle. The filing is a non-special situation update.
